decision.summary: The CP12 is valid until 16 Oct 2026, so the property is currently compliant but only for six more days. The tenant has ignored three contacts. I opened JOB-101, booked HeatRight (the landlord's preferred gas contractor, Gas Safe 550123) for 13 Oct, gave the tenant written notice by email, SMS and letter, and asked the landlord to approve the cost.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety? Which record do you trust and why?
answers.answer: Yes, until 16 Oct 2026. I trust compliance.json (the CP12 issued 2025-10-17, Gas Safe 550123, file CP12_2025.pdf), the current system record. The legacy note of 2 Nov 2025 ('renewed 2025, all good') is hearsay from the old agency and has no dates. It is consistent with the CP12 but not evidence. The EICR is valid to 2027 and the EPC to 2031.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Opened JOB-101, assigned HeatRight Ltd for Tue 13 Oct 9-12 (over 24h away and before expiry), and sent written notice by email, SMS and letter with a way to rearrange. Follow-up is set for 12 Oct to try other contact and rebook. There is no entry without the tenant's agreement. If there is still no contact, escalate before 16 Oct.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: I told Ben the expiry date, that the tenant hasn't responded, the booking with HeatRight, and the steps taken. I said the deadline doesn't move, that early booking keeps the anniversary date, and that the tenant gets a copy within 28 days. I asked him to approve the cost within his £300 limit by 12 Oct.

conflicts: Legacy note says cert renewed 2025; consistent with CP12 issued 2025-10-17, but the compliance record is trusted.

args.body: Hi Luca, your yearly gas safety check is due before 16 October and we haven't heard back. This is written notice that a Gas Safe engineer from HeatRight Ltd will visit on Tuesday 13 October, between 9am and 12pm. Someone aged 18+ needs to be home to let them in. If that doesn't suit, just reply or ring us with another time before 16 October and we'll rearrange. Booking early keeps your landlord's annual renewal date the same, and you'll get a copy of the safety record within 28 days of the check. If you ever smell gas, leave the property and call 0800 111 999. We'll be in touch again on Monday 12 October if we haven't heard from you.
